surprises.head: Winnipeg won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Colorado, 2.9 to 2.0, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Winnipeg tried a different line
surprises.body: A. Iafallo, A. Lowry, M. Barron played 11:01 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Winnipeg’s usual lines.
